ios.desc:
Tired of staring into a full fridge and thinking, "What's for dinner?" Stop the decision fatigue and unlock your kitchen's hidden potential with Chefiniti! Chefiniti is your personal AI chef, using advanced technology to turn the ingredients you already have into amazing, customized recipes in seconds. It's not just a recipe book—it's a recipe creator.

HOW IT WORKS: THE MAGIC OF "SCAN & CREATE"
Simply snap a photo of your fridge, pantry, or recent grocery haul. Chefiniti's smart AI analyzes everything, identifies your ingredients, and generates a list of delicious, easy-to-follow recipes you can make right now. Say goodbye to food waste and hello to effortless meal inspiration!

FEATURES THAT WILL REVOLUTIONIZE YOUR KITCHEN:

SCAN INGREDIENTS FROM A PHOTO
Don't know what to make? Just show us what you've got! Snap up to four photos of your ingredients, and our AI will instantly recognize them and build a list for you to review. It’s the fastest way from ingredients to inventory.

RECIPEFY ANY DISH
See a mouth-watering dish online or at a restaurant? Take a picture, and Chefiniti will generate a recipe so you can recreate it at home. It’s like having a food wizard in your pocket!

CREATE FROM A PROMPT
Have a specific idea? Just tell Chefiniti what you're craving. "A quick, healthy, gluten-free chicken pasta dish" or "A creative dessert using avocados and chocolate." Your wish is our command. Also featuring rich set of example ideas to get inspired from.

IMPORT RECIPES FROM THE WEB (Premium)
Found a recipe on your favorite blog? Use our URL importer to pull it into the app, reformat it beautifully, and save it to your cookbook forever.

SMART COOKBOOK 
Your personal, ever-expanding recipe collection. Save your favorite generated meals, edit them to perfection, or add your own family recipes from scratch with our built-in recipe editor. Bookmark your absolute favorites for quick access. Don't want to see AI-generated image on your favorite recipe? No problem - cook it yourself, and snap-replace the image.

INTEGRATED SHOPPING LISTS 
Our shopping list feature is seamlessly connected to your recipes. See a recipe you want to make? Add all its ingredients to a new or existing list with a single tap. Check off items as you shop and stay perfectly organized.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

Happy to share the project I've been vibe-coding on for past few months.
The Problem: Like many people, I often found myself staring at a fridge full of random ingredients (some about to expire) with no idea what to cook. I was tired of food waste and the repetitive cycle of making the same few meals. I wanted a way to creatively use what I already had.

The Solution: So, I decided to build Chefiniti. It's an iOS app that acts as a personal AI chef. The core idea is to turn your available food into delicious, custom recipes. I know there are already tons of apps like it but this one is mine :)

Here's what it can do:
* Scan Ingredients: Take photos of your fridge or pantry, and the app's vision model identifies the ingredients.
* "Recipefy" a Dish: See a meal you like online or in a restaurant? Snap a photo, and the app generates a recipe to help you recreate it.
* Generate from Prompt: Just describe what you're in the mood for (e.g., "a spicy, gluten-free pasta dish"), and it will create a recipe from scratch.
* Import from URL: Paste a link from a recipe website to import it into your cookbook.

You can also save all these recipes, create shopping lists, and set detailed preferences for diet, allergies, cuisine, and even the cookware you own.
App is in a freemium model, within limits you can really test out core features without any payment or even account creation.
